title: Chapter 269 The Knife-Wielding Boy
content:
Chapter 269 The Knife-Wielding Boy

In this way, another long period of time has passed.

Time flies.

Nine years have passed.

It has been ten years since Lu Xue went into seclusion to practice.

In the past ten years, the entire fairy world has also undergone tremendous changes.

Countless legendary terrifying powerful men were born one after another, stirring up the storm from the fairyland.

The entire fairyland was in turmoil for a while.

There are also a large number of talented monsters rising up, constantly refreshing everyone's cognition.

Awakening the bloodline of the golden crow, the terrifying immortal fire accompanied his body alone.

With the holy body of stars, the body brought about strange phenomena in heaven and earth as soon as it was born.

The immortal bones are born with the immortal spirit, and the aura of the immortal way crushes everything.

There are countless terrifying monsters.

At the same time, a large number of secret and blessed lands in the fairyland also broke out.

The competition is extremely fierce.

On this day, an uninvited guest suddenly came to Tiandi Academy.

boom!

A deafening roar sounded.

Everyone in the academy was shocked.

"Who dares to trek into the Tiandi Academy?!"

Angry shout came, and several powerful academy officials came one after another.

At the entrance of the academy, a young man holding a broken knife was smiling and looking inside the academy, extremely rebellious.

"Who dares to be so rude to Tiandi Academy?"

A strong man from the academy immediately scolded the young man.

Hearing this, the young man holding a knife smiled and said, "I heard that there are many talents in the Tiandi Academy, but I am not talented. I want to learn more."

As soon as these words were spoken, the strong man in the academy immediately understood.

It turned out to be here to discuss.

Since the construction of Tiandi Academy, many experts have wanted to come to the Academy to challenge.

In this regard, Tiandi Academy has never refused anyone to come.

But in the end, without exception.

Tiandi Academy has never lost.

Because the academy has the most inseparable are the genius strong people.

"Okay, since you are here to challenge, let me do it."

The strong man in the academy led no longer spoke, and then he entered the academy with a knife.

At the same time, he was also a little surprised.

When others come to challenge, they will more or less bring their own guardians with them.

Although the academy will not do those shameful things.

But just in case.

But the boy in front of him came alone.

He is so confident in his strength?

Along the way, many students in the academy heard the news and came out to visit them one after another.

"Challenge? Haha, there are really people who are not afraid of death to come to Tiandi Academy to challenge it."

"I haven't seen it for many years."

"Hehe, there's a good show now."

Most students scoffed at the teenagers who came to challenge.

Only a few people were silent, looking at the young man with a sharp look.

Soon, the boy with a knife stood on the competition platform of Tiandi Academy.

Bang!

A crisp metal collision sounded, and the knife-holding boy stood the broken knife in his hand on the ground with one hand.

"I have no Immortal Saint Realm in the middle stage. Don't come and try to touch the porcelain."

After saying that, a breath of the domineering immortal holy realm surged out of the boy's body.

The entire outer courtyard suddenly became silent.

The middle stage of the Immortal Saint Realm.

This kid is actually in the middle stage of the Immortal Saint Realm, how old is this!

The strong men from the academy who brought him in were also shocked.

At this time, a tutor from the outer school appeared in the venue.

"tutor."

When everyone saw the mentor, they immediately saluted.

Those strong men from the academy also said, "Sir."

"What's going on?"

The instructor frowned slightly.

Soon, the strong men from the academy told the mentor about the boy with a knife coming to challenge him.

"Mid-stage stage of the Immortal Saint Realm!"

Hearing this, the instructor was also shocked.

After a moment of silence, the instructor stepped forward and headed towards the boy.

The boy at this time looked disdainful.

"What, no one dares to fight in the entire Tiandi Academy?"

Hearing this, the students below clenched their fists, but they could do nothing.

In the Immortal Saint Realm, let alone in the outer courtyard, even in the inner courtyard, he is one of the few geniuses.

"Don't be arrogant, you have the will to go to the inner courtyard. What's the point of bullying us here?"

"That's right, I think you dare to be so arrogant in the inner courtyard."

"Haha, senior in the inner courtyard, I guess you will beat you to cry."

On the competition stand, the boy holding a knife grinned.

"Inner courtyard? It's interesting."

At the same time, the mentor also came to the young man.

"Brother, this place is not suitable for you. You are here to challenge, but you still have to choose an opponent with matching strength."

"I'll take you to the inner courtyard."

The instructor looked at the boy in front of him and said with a smile.

He didn't want the outer courtyard to be so scattered by this guy in front of him.

As an older generation of strong people, I cannot attack the young man in front of me, otherwise I will be ridiculed by the world.

When the boy heard the words of the mentor in front of him, he did not refute.

I just said impatiently, "Then let's go quickly, my time is precious."

Immediately, the tutor took the teenager away from the outer courtyard.

I don't know how long it took.

Inner courtyard.

On the huge competition stand, a young man stood proudly with a broken knife in his hand, looking around with disdain.

"I heard that there are many talents in the Tiandi Academy, but some people dare to fight me!"

The boy's voice was loud and soon spread throughout the inner courtyard.

For a moment, the inner courtyard was shocked.

Some people dare to come to Tiandi Academy to challenge it. They are so impatient.

Suddenly, a large number of students from the inner school came out of seclusion and rushed towards the competition platform.

"I'll fight you!"

Soon, a student in the inner school stood up.

The other students were immediately envious when they saw someone taking the lead.

"Damn it, he took the lead."

"Forget it, let's finish it quickly. I still have to go back to practice."

On the competition stand.

The student in the inner school looked cold and said indifferently: "Boy, come and report your name."

Hearing this, the young man holding the knife smiled and said, "You are not worthy of knowing my name."

As soon as these words came out, the student suddenly burst into veins.

"Arrogant!"

Below, everyone started to cheer.

"Gao Zhi, kill him!"

The cheers rang out, and Gao Zhi moved.

A fierce fist wind shouted directly at the sword-holding boy.

laugh!

The next moment, a sword light flashed by.

Blood spilled throughout the competition platform, and Gao Zhi was directly cut off the competition platform, fell into the crowd, losing consciousness.

The sound stopped abruptly.

The entire scene can be heard.

"Free kill!"

One person exclaimed in surprise.

Only then did everyone react and looked at the sword-holding boy on the stage again, and everyone's expressions gradually became solemn.

"Next."

At this time, on the stage, the young man holding the knife stood up again in his hand and spoke in a low voice.

This time, everyone dared not look down on it anymore.

Gao Zhi just now, although she was not very strong in the entire inner courtyard, she was definitely not weak.

Because he was also on the martial arts list.

But now, Gao Zhi was killed in seconds.

Facing the sword-holding boy, everyone was silent for a moment.

After a while, some people left here one after another.

It seems that I'm going to retaliate.

"No way? Is there no one in the Heaven and Earth Academy?"

Seeing that there was no movement, the young man with the knife continued to shout.
